subject.title: Fork-per-issue from one warmed repo box

question: Should Clownfish own an opt-in warmed snapshot-fork workspace backend for issue workers, and should that use mitos directly or wait for a crabbox lease primitive?
rationale: Current main has target-checkout plumbing but no warmed pool, and choosing the backend, rollout mode, cache policy, and isolation contract is a maintainer architecture decision rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Keep open for design
options.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

options.title: Wait for external primitive
options.body: Leave Clownfish on current temporary checkouts until mitos or crabbox exposes a stable lease primitive, then track only the integration work.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide warmed fork orchestration belongs entirely outside Clownfish.

recommendation.title: Keep open for design
recommendation.body: Specify an opt-in warmed lease contract with isolation, cache invalidation, cleanup, and ordinary-checkout fallback before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the clearest recent owner of the checkout, worker, and executor lifecycle code this architecture decision would affect.
